study_area: Kafr El Dawwar City (CITY ONLY — same verified boundary as the Indicators and 100 Million Trees projects)

monitoring.interpretation: The automation checks for new valid Sentinel-2 acquisitions. A new verified result is processed only when genuinely new imagery exists. A scheduled check does not fabricate a new result.

note_on_baseline: Sentinel-2A launched June 2015, so 2016 has usable but sparser coverage than later years. The accepted image count for 2016 is logged explicitly in Cell 3 and is never assumed.

ndvi_agricultural_threshold.source: Higher than the general 0.20 vegetation threshold used elsewhere in ENVA, to target dense agricultural/cropland signal rather than any green cover. PENDING_VALIDATION.

ndbi_builtup_threshold.source: Same threshold and NDBI-dominant rule used in the Indicators project's EUDI cell, for methodological consistency.

encroachment_definition: A pixel is classified as AGRICULTURAL ENCROACHMENT if it was agricultural (NDVI >= threshold, NDBI-dominant=False) in the baseline year AND is built-up (NDBI-dominant) in the comparison year. This is a satellite-derived change-detection proxy, not a legal/administrative determination of illegal encroachment.
